studios.brief: Drag-and-drop page builder for plain HTML and CSS sites.
studios.edits: The page's .html and .css files directly; every save is a commit.
good_for: landing pages and one-page marketing sites
laying out sections, columns and blocks by drag and drop
restyling an existing static page (colours, spacing, fonts) without touching code
studios.name: GrapesJS
not_for: blog posts or other long-form markdown content
React, Vue or other component-based apps
pages produced by a build step (it edits the HTML it is given, not a template)

studios.brief: Content editor for markdown sites (Hugo, Jekyll, Astro, 11ty).
studios.edits: Markdown files and their frontmatter under the content folders, plus uploads under static/; scaffolds admin/config.yml when it is missing.
good_for: writing and editing blog posts, docs pages and other markdown entries
frontmatter fields (title, date, tags, images) through forms
collections of similar entries, and uploading images to the site's media folder
studios.name: Decap CMS
not_for: page layout or visual design
composing pages from components
plain HTML sites with no static site generator

studios.brief: Visual content editing for Next.js, Astro and Hugo, in local mode.
studios.edits: Content files under content/ (markdown, MDX or JSON) and the tina/config schema.
good_for: editing page text and structured content inline, on a live preview of the running site
Next.js, Astro or Hugo sites whose content lives in markdown, MDX or JSON
people who would rather click on the page than fill in a form
studios.name: TinaCMS
not_for: building a layout from scratch
plain HTML sites with no build
changing component code or styles

studios.brief: Visual editor for React sites, built from the site's own components.
studios.edits: Only the page layout data (which components, in what order, with what props) under .tillandsias/studio/puck/; never component source.
good_for: composing pages from the React components the site already has, by drag and drop
landing and marketing pages inside a React app
letting non-developers rearrange sections without writing JSX
studios.name: Puck
not_for: markdown or blog content
creating or changing the components themselves
sites that are not React

studios.brief: Visual editor for Next.js and Tailwind. Needs a CodeSandbox account: its projects run in a cloud sandbox, not offline in the forge (measured, 1865-dn5h).
studios.edits: The app's own source under app/, src/ and components/ (not available offline in the forge).
good_for: visually editing the layout and Tailwind styles of a Next.js app, written back to code
studios.name: Onlook
not_for: offline use: it needs a CodeSandbox account and runs projects in a cloud sandbox
markdown content
sites that are not Next.js

studios.brief: Node-based image generation on the local models, outputs to the lane's scratch volume.
studios.edits: Nothing in the checkout: outputs land in the lane's scratch volume (/work/tmp/imagegen), and the agent commits the ones the user keeps.
good_for: generating or editing images: hero art, illustrations, icons, sprites, textures
image-to-image and inpainting with the local models
building a repeatable image workflow the agent can rerun with studio.run_workflow
studios.name: ComfyUI
not_for: editing site pages, text or code
anything that must change files in the checkout directly

studios.brief: Audio analysis and transforms (ffmpeg, sox, rubberband, a glitch detector) on the lane's audio scratch volume, with provenance.
studios.edits: Nothing in the checkout: outputs land in the lane's audio scratch volume (/work/tmp/audio), each with a provenance record, and the agent commits the ones the user keeps.
good_for: finding clicks, dropouts, spectral holes, clipping and loop seams in audio, with their time ranges
converting audio to Opus or AAC for the web or a game build
studios.name: Audio Studio
not_for: composing or generating new music (generative tools are order 2055-dihg)
separating a mix into stems (order 2055-d9sa)
editing audio by hand on a timeline: it has no window
